native_assembly_type: Fixed-position reference; no driven motion mates
drawing_source: Matching R2 STEP button and seven unchanged V11 STEP sources at assembly positions; exploded view adds display offsets only. PCB reference omits full flexible cable and some unmodeled details.
limits: Rigid geometry only; adhesive choice/strength, print tolerances, switch return and real assembly unverified.
Full FPC bend and assembly forces not simulated; do not hinge the screen on the FPC root.
Battery envelope 42x30x4 supplied by user; seal, leads and expansion require dry fit.
PCB fixing requires a bonded dielectric laminate, 0.3mm installed including adhesive on both faces.
Four assumed solder pockets removed; real solder protrusion is unmeasured. Nominal board-back to flat floor gap is 0.3mm, not a solder-height allowance certification.
J3 intentionally not fitted; U6 VRML represented by additional nominal box; C32 full height additionally checked.
Old connector STEP does not establish actual drawer travel; connect and lock FPC before closing screen.
Print fit, friction, switch return and actuation require actual dry fit.
No independent return spring; cap can float within original 0.35mm lost motion.
Larger transverse clearance allows some tilt; no force or tilted-contact simulation.
Unchanged original full PCB edge-first insertion/FPC and adhesive qualifications remain pending.
